records.topic: Iran-China oil supply under blockade pressure
records.finding: Reuters reported Iranian crude supply to China around 534,000 bpd so far in August versus about 1.4m bpd average in 2025, with lower floating stocks, reduced Sep/Oct offers and Chinese buyer substitution.
records.causation_note: Supports severe supply contraction and commercial adaptation; does not establish China abandoned Iran.

records.finding: World Bank projected 2026 GDP contraction of 6.4% and inflation around 17.5%, saying renewed conflict derailed fragile recovery.
records.causation_note: Use World Bank conflict assessment; do not assign the entire macroeconomic contraction specifically to Iran or Hezbollah.
